description:
Front Garden (Front Boundary) 

T1: Lime tree (next to gate) 
•	Reduce height by approximately 0.5 - 1m through selective thinning, hitting suitable grow points
•	Thin out trunk growth by 10% 
•	Remove major deadwood

Height of tree currently:  10M
Height of tree after reduction: 9M

Spread of tree currently: 6M
Spread of tree after reduction: 5M


T2: Second lime tree 
•	Reduce height to stand approximately 0.5ft off previous pollard points (approximately 1 - 1.5m reduction)
•	Thin out epicormic growth in trunk 10% , retaining sufficient growth to maintain screening from the house
•	Remove major deadwood 

Height of tree currently:  10M
Height of tree after reduction: 9M

Spread of tree currently: 6M
Spread of tree after reduction: 5M

Reasons for work: 
General tree maintenance 
More light 
Lift over road low trees
Maintaining tree in its current setting
Reduce shading to house 
Suppressing growth of shrubs
Overhanging footpath 
Landscaping garden
